facts.detail: BDUK published the annual 2025/26 delivery-performance official statistics on 11 June 2026.
The release covers premises receiving gigabit-capable coverage through BDUK subsidy from 1 April 2025 to 31 March 2026.
BDUK estimates that its interventions delivered gigabit-capable broadband coverage to 192,570 premises in 2025/26.
Annual delivery was 42,280 premises, or 28%, higher than in the previous financial year.
The estimated cumulative total delivered since the launch of BDUK gigabit programmes reached 1,418,410 premises.

facts.detail: Gigabit Infrastructure Subsidy contracts accounted for 72% of annual delivery, or 139,490 premises.
Voucher schemes accounted for 16% of annual delivery, or 30,530 premises.
Superfast and Hubs interventions accounted for the remaining 12%, or 22,550 premises.
GIS figures exclude contracts in which BDUK is not the leading authority.
The release attributes annual growth primarily to GIS expansion while legacy interventions continued to decline.

facts.detail: England accounted for 145,110 delivered premises, or 75% of annual delivery.
Scotland accounted for 30,530 delivered premises, or 16%.
Wales accounted for 15,430 delivered premises, or 8%.
Northern Ireland accounted for 1,470 delivered premises, or 1%.
Rural areas accounted for 173,190 premises, or 90% of annual delivery.

facts.detail: Residential properties accounted for 173,270 delivered premises, or 90%.
Commercial properties accounted for 17,790 delivered premises, or 9%.
An estimated 43,880 premises, or 23%, did not previously have superfast broadband of at least 30 Mbit/s.
The South West recorded 27,630 delivered premises, the highest English regional total.
Yorkshire and the Humber recorded 27,090 delivered premises.

facts.detail: The annual report used BDUK management information as of 15 May 2026.
The report used the December 2025 National Statistics UPRN Lookup.
The report used the February 2026 National Statistics Postcode Lookup.
The report used Ofcom Connected Nations data from the Spring 2026 update.
